failureModes: 32GB WSL cap is proven only for the current short-context host/WSL Q4 workflow, not for long-context, Docker-heavy, Pi/browser, or multi-agent tests.
WSL Vulkan currently exposes CPU llvmpipe only.
OpenCode 4k context overflows with this profile.
OpenCode 8k can make correct edits but may loop or fail to terminate.
The model misunderstood DOM hidden semantics in unprotected frontend tasks.
Gemma E4B Q4 does not load in AMD llama.cpp b8407 because the GGUF architecture is gemma4.
Qwen2.5-Coder 1.5B Q4/Q8 are fast but failed js-window with syntax-invalid edits.
